source_coordinate_conventions.world: Common predicted VGGT-Ω world; no axis realignment applied.
source_coordinate_conventions.extrinsics: world_to_camera maps world homogeneous column vectors to camera coordinates.
source_coordinate_conventions.intrinsics: Pixel coordinates; intrinsics_canonical applies to the original oriented image.
source_coordinate_conventions.blender: camera_to_world_blender_camera_basis flips local Y/Z only; world alignment remains necessary.
source_coordinate_conventions.depth: Optical-axis camera Z depth, not Euclidean ray distance.
source_coordinate_conventions.scale: Arbitrary learned scale shared by this joint inference; not meters. Align by a similarity transform.
source_coordinate_conventions.confidence: Uncalibrated upstream confidence score, not a probability or error bound.

preprocessing.pixel_coordinates: Integer coordinates are pixel centers; PIL half-pixel resize convention.

selection.strategy: stride candidates plus final frame, evenly capped over full duration

source_point_cloud.note: Depth-unprojected colored points; duplicates and dynamic objects are retained.

world_coordinate_conventions.origin: Intersection of the leveled artwork-wall datum and the floor, in the transverse plane through the first VGGT camera center.

fitting: Global major horizontal and artwork-wall planes initialized by RANSAC, refined by successively trimmed least squares using every 31st PLY vertex. Axes are orthonormal and right-handed.

metric_scale_anchor.physical_reference: Dining table upper surface, assumed to be 0.75 m above the finished floor.
metric_scale_anchor.reason: No survey, tape measure, known model dimensions, or independently calibrated metric reference was supplied.
metric_scale_anchor.method: Median 3D position among eight nearest reprojected source-frame-0 points for each click. Use median floor clearance across clicks.
metric_scale_anchor.illustrative_sensitivity: A table actually 0.72–0.78 m high changes all reported lengths by −4% to +4%. This is a sensitivity example, not a measured confidence interval.

coverage: Dense support on the visible floor strips, dining top, art wall, canvas faces, window-wall pier, television, coffee-table areas and sofa upholstery facing the lens.
Large unsampled regions run through the open center of the room, opaque window shades and glazing, much of the ceiling, and the space behind the sectional.
Undersides, hidden furniture supports, floor concealed by furnishings, and thin cords/rails generally have poor direct observations.
Chrome, glass, TV content, and the lit fireplace are liable to inconsistent depths. The hearth opening is largely missing from the VGGT interior returns.

Individual depth pixels from different camera locations can duplicate static surfaces with centimeter offsets. Corners, small objects and grazing surfaces are less well constrained. No local warping was applied.
reference_storage: All native coordinates, byte RGB values, per-point confidence and source frame IDs are retained in a separate hidden-render collection. Its mesh object transform stores the similarity. A deterministic inspection sample displays alongside authored geometry.

secondary_scale_check.feature: Outer corners of the duplex wall plate near the black side table
secondary_scale_check.method: Intersect independent ray picks from VGGT frames 344 and 347 with the wall-plate plane at Y=8.095 m in the estimated metric scene.
secondary_scale_check.comparison: A commercial standard-size North American duplex wallplate (Leviton 88003) is 0.06985 m wide and 0.11430 m high. The installed model is unidentified. Agreement within a few percent is a plausibility check; this measurement did not set the scale.

authored_surface_validation.metric: Unsigned Euclidean distance in meters from each sampled reference point to the nearest evaluated authored triangle, at Blender frame 1.
authored_surface_validation.sampling: Deterministic every 83rd original vertex. Region selectors use world-space boxes and a color predicate for the display. The all-sampled statistic includes occluders, duplicate observations and outliers. Nearest surfaces can belong to adjacent objects.

largest_populated_cell_discrepancies.criterion: Largest median nearest-mesh distance among populated 30 cm cells with at least 30 samples from seven source frames.

revision_checks.description: Comparison of the same PLY-sample cells and same nearest-triangle metric before and after focused geometry revisions. Frames, camera registration and the global transform remained fixed.

inspection_images.method: Orthographic depth-buffered projections of Blender-evaluated triangular surfaces, at source frame 0. The clay-style material colors prioritize geometry and omit surface textures. Every 17th PLY point, transformed with the published matrix, supplies the cyan comparison layer; receding points more than 0.10 m behind the visible model are suppressed. The discrepancy panel uses the separate every-83rd-point BVH evaluation.
